title: Train a LoRA with core nodes

questions.q: In TrainLoraNode, what does a single step measure with its loss?
options: How much the picture looks like the trigger
How far the model's prediction of the clean latent is from the real clean latent, at a random noise level
How close the LoRA is to the checkpoint
questions.answer: How far the model's prediction of the clean latent is from the real clean latent, at a random noise level
questions.why: fwd_bwd makes xt from a random sigma and noise, predicts x0, and compares it with the clean latent.

questions.q: In our 300-step run the first tenth averaged 0.1626 and the last 0.1849. What should you conclude?
options: Nothing: the shuffle test shows such a gap appears about half the time by chance
questions.answer: Nothing: the shuffle test shows such a gap appears about half the time by chance
questions.why: Random noise levels and pictures make the list so jumpy that this gap isn't evidence either way. The pictures still changed.

questions.q: Why does a LoRA trained with these core nodes not patch the text encoder?
options: The captions were encoded once before training, and adapters are added only to the model
It's a setting you must turn on
questions.answer: The captions were encoded once before training, and adapters are added only to the model
questions.why: MakeTrainingDataset encodes text ahead of time. _setup_lora_adapters walks mp.model only.

questions.q: What does our run actually show?
options: This path produces a file that changes pictures, in one run with two test prompts
questions.answer: This path produces a file that changes pictures, in one run with two test prompts
questions.why: One run has no comparison in it. It can't rank settings.

questions.q: Your run crashes at step 280 of 300. What do you have?
options: Nothing from that run: the node saves no mid-run checkpoints
questions.answer: Nothing from that run: the node saves no mid-run checkpoints
questions.why: SaveLoRA runs only after TrainLoraNode returns.
